Class RouxProperties

java.lang.Object
org.roux.RouxProperties
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="roux") public class RouxProperties extends Object
The RouxProperties type holds the settings whose prefix is roux. The page size starts at 1048576 bytes. The maximum frame size starts at 0. The resident page cap starts at 2. The durability text starts as commit. A RouxProperties.Spill object, a RouxProperties.Crypto object, and a RouxProperties.Session object are created with the settings. A caller reads a value or replaces it. normalizedDurability() returns hot-only, commit, or append. isRamOnly() is true for hot-only durability, a missing spill block, or a spill block that is off. A missing session block keeps persist, restore, and exclusive on. The setters store the value they receive. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxProperties roux-design.md

    • normalizedDurability

      public String normalizedDurability()
      The method returns one of three durability names. A null value returns commit. The stored text is trimmed and compared in lower case. hot-only and h0 return hot-only. append and h2 return append. Every other value returns commit.
      Returns:
      The name is hot-only, commit, or append.
